Katapult · Photography for social and banners

Katapult Image Library

Lifestyle photos of people at home with what they bought: phones, laptops, sofas, appliances, deliveries. Each one is graded against the photography rules in the Design System, with where copy can sit. Click a photo for a large preview, its Adobe Stock ID and its file path. Updated 2026-10-13.

    On-brand

    A real person is the focal point, face visible, smiling or engaged, bright and natural. Use as the main image.

    With care

    Eyes closed, dim light, busy frame or face turned away. Fine as a supporting image or after a re-crop; not as the hero.

    No people

    Rooms and products only. The guideline never allows them as the main image; use them behind a product or in a collage.

    Scene
    Brand fit
    Shape
    Previews are compressed. Use the original at the path shown, under clients/katapult/01-brand/photos/ (on disk and OneDrive, outside git). Built by photos/build_image_library.py from library/catalog.md.
